title: Topic
description: A topic is a self-contained map: a framework, a set of principles, and results relating them.

require_sources.description: Reject result/model records without a nonempty source. Opt in for existing datasets; enabled for new topics.

source_catalog.description: Direct sources used to classify and filter results and models. Miscellaneous records use the reserved id misc.

principle_categories.description: Ordered display categories for the principle filter. Principles refer to these ids via category.

framework.description: The setting all principles are stated in: the objects, the primitive relation(s), standing conventions. Every result is a claim about this framework.

background.description: Principle ids assumed throughout. Every implication and independence is read relative to these.

background_presets.description: Named, removable viewer assumption packages and abbreviations for equivalent conjunctions. Defaults apply only when the URL has no explicit assume parameter. Abbreviations do not change stored premises or model assertions.

notation.description: Optional notation guide shown in the viewer.

lean_lib.description: Lake library name under topics/<topic>/lean/, e.g. UnboundedUtility.
